text:
Priya S: Hey team — Auriga's POC kicked off. They want to run Orchid-40B but with customer-supplied 4-bit QLoRA weights and KMS in front. Main asks: compatibility, memory footprint estimate, and any enterprise blockers for hosted vs dedicated.

Miguel R: @Priya S ok. Quick q — are they set on hosted or open to Dedicated? Hosted probably easiest but KMS + customer weights -> private deployment usually required.

Priya S: They're flexible. Main constraint is that weights cannot leave their AWS account. They prefer a VPC/private deployment but want pricing delta vs hosted.

Asha K: Re: model variant — our runtime supports 4-bit QLoRA variants but we need to confirm the quantization layout. If the customer used q4_k_m layout we should be fine. Need a snippet of model config.

Priya S: Sharing model config they sent:
```
base_model: "orchid-40b"
adapter: "qlora-4bit-v1"
quant_layout: "q4_k_m"
embedding_size: 12288
```

Asha K: Perfect — that looks compatible. Expect memory per GPU ~28GB with KV cache disabled or warm caching; with KV cache for long contexts (8k) we'd need 40GB. Batch sizing: 8 concurrent streams per A100-40.

Jon L: infra notes: For Private VPC deployment with customer-managed weights we need to add S3 mount + role assumption. Network egress will be zero if kept in VPC. We'll need a short infra runbook; I can draft.

Nina (Security): Security checklist: KMS key policy, audit logs, SOC2 controls. If weights are customer-owned and never hosted, we treat them as "bring-your-own-weights" and require HMAC-signed manifest during ingest. Also require encrypt-at-rest for model cache.

Priya S: Pricing ask — can you give a rough pricing delta: hosted vs Dedicated (monthly) vs Private on-prem? Customer wants order-of-magnitude.

Miguel R: Rough numbers: hosted inference (orchid-40b quant) ~ $X per 1M tokens (we bill hosted token unit). Dedicated reserved: $Y/month per GPU equivalent (includes commit). Private (VPC + support) = dedicated base + enterprise fee (~+20-30%). I'll put better numbers once Asha confirms GPU sizing.

Asha K: Estimate after rounding: 1x A100-80 ~ supports ~25 rps 512-token requests with quant-v2 variant. For the customer's adapter + 8k contexts plan for 2x A100-80 for headroom. So Dedicated price = base GPU *2. Hosted would route to multitenant quant pool so unit cost slightly lower but can't meet customer weights requirement.

Priya S: Great. Any blockers to sign POC? Ops concerns?

Jon L: Blocker: we need legal sign-off on BYOW manifest & S3 access. Also automated scrubbers for telemetry to avoid collecting weights. I can add to runbook.

Nina (Security): Also need to answer their security questionnaire — send me the questionnaire PDF. We'll add KMS/manifest language.

Priya S: I uploaded the questionnaire: https://files.example.com/auriga-poc-sec.pdf

Asha K: One more technical note: if they insist on QLoRA repo format, we might need a small adapter to convert to our loader. I can PR a converter; quick patch.

Miguel R: Action items:
- @Asha K: prototype loader + sizing PR (due in 48h)
- @Jon L: infra runbook + S3 role template (48h)
- @Nina (Security): review questionnaire & draft BYOW manifest wording (72h)
- @Priya S: confirm POC timelines and whether they'll accept Dedicated or insist on Private

deploy-bot: Deployed branch "qlora-loader-proto" to staging at 5234567020 :rocket:

Priya S: Nice — thanks. I'll push back to customer that Dedicated/VPC is recommended and share the action items.

Miguel R: If anyone needs cost numbers to include in the SOW, ping me and I'll produce a short spreadsheet.

Priya S: 👍 keeping thread open. Will update when customer confirms dedicated vs private.
